threat_event: Ransomware encrypts core and payments servers in the group data centers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Core and payments servers reachable from branch and operations networks through shared identity
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.h); 12 CFR 53.3
existing_controls: EDR; PAM; immutable backups; semiannual failover test
treatment_plan: Isolated recovery environment; quarterly core restore test

threat_event: The bank releases a fraudulent wire on instructions from a compromised business customer, including an affiliate
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The bank follows the customer's agreed security procedure; a fooled customer approver defeats the bank callback
existing_controls: Dual control; callback to independently verified numbers for new beneficiaries over $1 million; payment fraud model
treatment_plan: Out-of-band confirmation from a second customer officer for new beneficiaries over $5 million; affiliates onboarded as treasury clients with the same controls

threat_event: A platform outage or suspension over 4 hours stops bank digital banking and business payments
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: The bank depends on one affiliate platform for digital channels
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1.h); 12 CFR 53.3
existing_controls: Warm standby region; branch and phone fallback
treatment_plan: Joint bank and platform contingency plan including deliberate suspension decisions

threat_event: The payment initiation gateway fails and digital wires and ACH stop
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single cluster in the primary data center with a cold standby; failover never tested
existing_controls: Monitoring; vendor support
treatment_plan: Hot standby in the secondary data center; failover test

threat_event: Business account takeover through stolen business user credentials
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Business users can be phished; MFA required in the bank tenant
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B II.B.3; III.C.1.a)
existing_controls: Required MFA; device binding; step-up for new beneficiaries
treatment_plan: Phishing-resistant options for business administrators

threat_event: Consumer account takeover through SIM swap or credential phishing
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SMS one-time codes still accepted for consumers
existing_controls: Risk-based MFA; device binding; fraud model
treatment_plan: App-based push and passkeys; SIM-swap signal from carriers

threat_event: A wire operations insider colludes to send an unauthorized wire
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two-person integrity can be defeated by collusion
existing_controls: Dual control; rotation; background checks; post-release review
treatment_plan: Keep; analytics on maker-checker pairs

threat_event: Core software vendor maintenance access is abused
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor needs periodic privileged access
existing_controls: PAM with recording and approval
treatment_plan: Keep; quarterly review of recorded vendor sessions

threat_event: The card processor has a prolonged outage
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single processor for debit and ATM
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.D.3); 12 CFR 53.4 (inbound)
existing_controls: Processor SOC 1 review; stand-in limits
treatment_plan: Annual joint exercise; confirm the processor holds the bank's designated notice contact

threat_event: AI credit model adverse action notices give reasons that do not match the model's cash-flow drivers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Reason codes mapped before cash-flow attributes were added in 2026-03
regulatory_driver: ECOA and Regulation B (12 CFR 1002.9(b)(2)); N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B III.C.1)
existing_controls: Model risk management validation; compliance review of notices
treatment_plan: Remap reason codes; corrected notices; validation re-test (P10 conditions)
owner: Bank consumer and small business lending executive

threat_event: The AI credit model produces approval disparities through proxy variables
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Cash-flow and geography-related attributes can act as proxies
existing_controls: Pre-deployment fairness testing for consumer loans
treatment_plan: Quarterly fairness testing for both products; less discriminatory alternative search

threat_event: A notification incident determination is made late or not recorded
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Criteria do not address incidents that start in affiliates or deliberate platform suspensions
existing_controls: Bank incident plan with determination step
treatment_plan: Add affiliate and suspension triggers to the determination criteria (P08)

threat_event: Weaknesses at the affiliate platform go unnoticed by the bank
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: SOC reports not reviewed; CUECs not mapped; intercompany agreement lacks notice terms
existing_controls: Group third-party policy
treatment_plan: Annual SOC review and CUEC mapping; amended intercompany agreement
owner: Head of Technology and Cyber Risk

threat_event: The payment fraud model (AI-002) drifts and misses new patterns
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Quarterly retraining
existing_controls: Fraud operations review; monitoring
treatment_plan: Monthly challenger model and loss feedback
owner: Bank contact center and fraud director

threat_event: The AML alert prioritization model (AI-003) suppresses true suspicious activity
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Low-scored alerts reviewed on a sample basis
regulatory_driver: 12 CFR 21.11; N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B Supp. A II.A.1.c)
existing_controls: Below-threshold sampling; model validation
treatment_plan: Keep; semiannual validation

threat_event: The contact center generative assistant gives wrong information or reveals data to an unverified caller
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant drafts answers for agents
existing_controls: Agents verify callers before the assistant sees account data
treatment_plan: Output sampling; answer grounding checks
owner: Bank contact center and fraud director

threat_event: DDoS against bank digital channels
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Internet-facing channels
existing_controls: Provider DDoS protection; WAF
treatment_plan: Annual DDoS test

threat_event: A stolen workforce session reaches the bank tenant console (entitlements and limits)
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 12-hour sessions; no step-up for limit changes by staff
existing_controls: Daily review of limit and beneficiary changes
treatment_plan: Step-up for staff limit and entitlement changes; device-bound sessions

threat_event: Data center power or cooling fails
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Two data centers; generator and UPS
existing_controls: Hot secondary data center; generator tests
treatment_plan: Keep; annual full-load generator test

threat_event: A branch laptop is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Mobile staff
existing_controls: Full-disk encryption; remote wipe
treatment_plan: Accepted by the bank business information security officer (Low)

threat_event: Malware on teller workstations
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many branch workstations
existing_controls: EDR; application allow-listing
treatment_plan: Keep; quarterly allow-list review

threat_event: Bank customer information is over-shared in enterprise data platform extracts
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Many analytics users
existing_controls: Extract filter; access approvals
treatment_plan: Quarterly access recertification for bank extracts
owner: Group chief data and analytics officer

threat_event: The loan origination SaaS vendor is breached
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor holds application data including credit reports
existing_controls: SOC review; contract notice terms
treatment_plan: Confirm the vendor's notice contact and data return terms
owner: Bank consumer and small business lending executive

threat_event: Cyber risk appetite metrics reach the bank board late
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Manual aggregation across registers
existing_controls: Quarterly report
treatment_plan: Automate the metric feed (GR-16)

threat_event: Retired core storage media are not sanitized
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Media leave the data centers for destruction
regulatory_driver: N52-R02 (12 CFR 30 App. B II.B.4; III.C.4)
existing_controls: Certified destruction with serial-number certificates
treatment_plan: Keep; annual vendor audit

threat_event: A core administrator account is compromised
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Powerful core roles
existing_controls: PAM; phishing-resistant MFA; session recording
treatment_plan: Quarterly review of core administrator sessions

threat_event: ATM skimming or jackpotting
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Off-site ATMs
existing_controls: Anti-skimming devices; hardened ATM images; processor fraud monitoring
treatment_plan: Accepted by the bank business information security officer (Low)

threat_event: A fraudster social-engineers the contact center to change a customer's phone or email, then moves money
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Callback relies on contact details the fraudster changed
existing_controls: Caller verification; change notifications to old contact details
treatment_plan: Hold on payments for 48 hours after a contact change
owner: Bank contact center and fraud director
